literal: With modesty, good manliness formerly I possessed; today I possess the palmyra stem mounted by those who are infatuated.
translation: I once possessed modesty and excellent manly fortitude. Today, I possess only the palmyra-stem chariot ridden by the infatuated.
modern: முன்பு நான் நாணமும் சிறந்த ஆண்மையும் உடையவனாக இருந்தேன். ஆனால் இன்று காதல் கொண்டவர்கள் ஏறும் மடலையே உடையவனாக இருக்கிறேன்.
explanation: The speaker contrasts his dignified past with his desperate present state caused by intense love. Formerly, he possessed modesty and manly fortitude, which kept his emotions in check. Now, overwhelmed by infatuation, he has lost those virtues and possesses only the palmyra stem. This refers to the ancient Tamil practice of riding a rough chariot made of jagged palmyra stems to publicly declare unrequited love, showing a complete abandonment of shame.
